summary: OUTPOST COMMANDER is an educational space simulation game inspired by NASA's vision of future lunar exploration. Players take command of a Moon outpost and are responsible for managing essential resources, including electricity, oxygen, water, and food. They must maintain life-support systems, protect the crew from radiation, and respond to unexpected challenges while keeping the outpost operational. Every decision affects the mission, encouraging players to develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and resource-management skills. By combining space science with interactive gameplay, OUTPOST COMMANDER aims to make learning engaging and introduce students to the real-world challenges of establishing sustainable human habitats beyond Earth.
details:
Project Summary – Outpost Commander

Outpost Commander is an interactive, educational space-management game where players take charge of a lunar research outpost supporting four astronauts. Over five turns, players make important decisions about managing electricity, water, oxygen, food, and radiation protection to keep the astronauts safe and the mission successful.

The project helps students understand the challenges of living on the Moon, develops problem-solving and decision-making skills, and encourages interest in space exploration. Its intended impact is to make space science more engaging and accessible, especially for students aged 7–12.

The game was developed using Lovable on Android, branching scenarios, and interactive choices. I used AI for coding and debugging.

Its creativity comes from transforming real lunar survival challenges into an interactive game where every decision has consequences and can lead to different mission outcomes.

Our team considered scientific accuracy, simplicity, accessibility, age-appropriate learning, resource management, and NASA's vision for sustainable lunar exploration.

I would like to add that I made this project using only an Android phone and i might have made this project on 13th November, that is before the hackathon started, so if there's any issue do let me know!!
